checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One ~8s widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting
must.why: 8 s 16:9 flat cartoon; seed grows into a seedling.

must.item: Voice-over says script verbatim, no extra lines
must.why: Audio exists but words not transcribed.

must.item: Water reaches seed, roots down, shoot up toward light in order
must.why: No visible water at start; the 'roots' look like pale tentacles hanging off a mushroom-like seed; seed appears to rise out of the soil, and the shoot has a big leaf pair. Order is only loosely met.
Stages are visible but the audio timing is unknown.
No text visible in frames; music cannot be judged from the numbers.

exact_text.text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text visible (desired); spoken words cannot be verified.

faults.what: The seed looks like a jellyfish or mushroom, with roots dangling as tentacles with drips, which reads wrongly as roots growing downward.
No clear water stage; only small drops at 3.2 s.
The scene is not a clear side cross-section. Foliage and a small plant in the background distract, and the seed starts at the soil surface.
The seed morphs into a seedling abruptly; the shoot doesn't visibly emerge from the seed.
The narration wording could not be verified.

summary: A pleasant flat-cartoon 8 s clip ends in a nice seedling, but the middle stage shows odd jellyfish-like roots, the water stage is unclear, and the narration is unverified.
